picks.title: Google Opens AI Mode to Prescription Drug Ads
picks.excerpt: The test, which began this month, brings one of advertising’s most regulated categories into Google’s AI answers.
picks.rationale: New ad inventory: Google opens AI Mode answers to Rx pharma advertisers, a regulated category entering an AI-assistant ad surface for the first time.

picks.title: Google Ads Testing Google AI For Goals & Assets
picks.excerpt: Google is testing using AI to come up with suggested goals and assets for your Google Ads campaigns.  Google has confirmed this is a current test.
picks.rationale: Google-confirmed test where AI proposes campaign goals and creative assets at setup, which changes how advertisers build Google Ads campaigns.

picks.title: Olyzon's AI agents now shift CTV budgets across 4 DSPs in live buys
picks.excerpt: Buyers keep seats at Trade Desk, Amazon DSP, DV360 and Yahoo DSP while caps and audit logs bound each agent. What do the partner lists and missing figures show?
picks.rationale: Agentic media buying in live CTV campaigns across four major DSPs, with spend caps and audit logs; a concrete deployment rather than a forecast.

picks.title: First for THG Commerce as company brings Criteo Sponsored Products to AI Shopping Assistant solution
picks.excerpt: THG Commerce, part of THG Ingenuity, has integrated Criteo Sponsored Products into its AI Shopping Assistant, built using Google Cloud’s Gemini Enterprise. THG Commerce says it is the first commerce technology provider in Europe to bring Criteo Sponsored Products into AI-powered conversational search.
picks.rationale: Retail-media sponsored products now served inside a Gemini-built conversational shopping assistant, a new placement for paid listings in AI chat.

picks.title: Turning Opportunistic AI Inference Capacity Into Better Ads Recommendations
picks.excerpt: At Meta, we’ve built a system that enhances ads recommendations by leveraging idle inference capacity in our fleet. Two elasticity levers in the system allow ads recommendation work to expand acros…
picks.rationale: Primary source from Meta on how idle AI inference capacity is put to work on ad-ranking models, the delivery engine behind Meta's ad auctions.

alternates.title: Media Buying Briefing: Synthetic audience adoption by agencies and clients takes off
alternates.excerpt: Media planners, creative strategists and CMOs are basing marketing decisions on insights gleaned from the behavior of synthetic consumers.
alternates.rationale: Synthetic AI audiences now used for media planning; distinct from the 10-11 agentic-rogue-fears piece (history_match related, nearest https://digiday.com/media-buying/as-agencies-push-agentic-media-future-execs-work-to-ward-off-client-rogue-fears/).

alternates.title: Bannerflow now scores ads for attention before any budget is spent
alternates.excerpt: Attention heatmaps and clarity scores join image tools and plain-language feed setup in one suite. Still missing: release dates, pricing and proof scores work.
alternates.rationale: AI pre-flight attention scoring for ad creative; vendor launch without dates or pricing, so ranked below the picks.

alternates.title: As AI agents begin shopping, brands are changing their sales pitch
alternates.source: The Seattle Times (The New York Times)
alternates.excerpt: "When an AI agent goes shopping, how does it decide what to buy?" is the question on every marketing executive’s mind as customers increasingly turn to AI for recommendations.
alternates.rationale: Feature on brands adapting to agent shoppers; a trend piece overlapping recent agent-commerce coverage, kept as backup only.
